te: Draft report reviewed, and proposals on seed added
se: The meeting reviewed the draft report on "Approaches to Supporting, Promoting and Developing Thailand's Integrated Rice System" and added views, for example on seed, proposing that the Rice Department seriously support rice variety research and development and produce a wide range of seed
it: Review of the draft report on approaches to supporting, promoting and developing Thailand's integrated rice system

te: Draft report on developing an integrated rice system considered
se: The meeting considered the draft study report on "Approaches to Supporting, Promoting and Developing Thailand's Integrated Rice System", which consists of an introduction, information on rice production and marketing in Thailand and the world, and further chapters
it: Draft study report on approaches to supporting, promoting and developing Thailand's integrated rice system

te: Briefing by rice millers, exporters and the Ministry of Energy on rice markets and energy costs
se: The meeting considered ways to support rice production in marketing and in cutting farmers' energy costs, inviting the Thai Rice Mills Association, the Thai Rice Exporters Association and the Ministry of Energy. Key issues included improving rice quality to meet market demand, rice standards, price stability, and links between farmers, mills and exporters
it: Rice marketing and cutting farmers' energy costs

te: Framework set for the draft study report on an integrated rice system
se: The meeting considered the framework and approach for the draft study report, aiming to gather the facts, problems and obstacles of the whole rice system, from production and processing to marketing, and to analyse costs, yield increases, quality improvement and rice management
it: Framework and approach for preparing the draft study report

te: Results of the farmland lease law studied, and proposals for improvement
se: The meeting studied the results of enforcing the Agricultural Land Lease Act B.E. 2524 (1981) and its amendment of B.E. 2559 (2016), and proposals to review and amend it, inviting the Minister of Agriculture and Cooperatives and the Minister of Interior as the ministers responsible for the Act. A representative of the Department of Provincial Administration gave information on reviewing secondary legislation in line with the definition of "agriculture"
it: Results of enforcement and proposals to amend the Agricultural Land Lease Act B.E. 2524 (1981) and its amendment of B.E. 2559 (2016)

te: Enforcement of the agricultural land lease law followed up
se: The meeting considered progress under the Agricultural Land Lease Act B.E. 2524 (1981) and its amendment of B.E. 2559 (2016), inviting the Permanent Secretary for Interior. A representative of the Department of Provincial Administration explained the setting up of agricultural land lease committees at provincial and subdistrict level in every area, and the provision of information about this law in every district
it: Progress under the Agricultural Land Lease Act B.E. 2524 (1981) and its amendment of B.E. 2559 (2016)

te: Briefing by the Department of Agriculture and the Land Development Department on support for rice production
se: The meeting heard a representative of the Department of Agriculture on technical support, such as pest control, research into pest control technology, and outbreak monitoring and warnings, and a representative of the Land Development Department on soil support for rice growing

te: Briefing by the community rice centre network and the farmers' council
se: The meeting exchanged views with representatives of the national community rice centre network, the Community Rice Centre Association (Thailand) and the farmers' council on the role of community rice centres in developing rice production, such as the project to promote replacing rice seed, and proposals to raise rice farmers' income sustainably
it: The work of community rice centres, and proposals to raise rice farmers' income

te: The role of the Department of Agriculture in rice production considered
se: The meeting considered the work of agricultural agencies to support rice production, especially the Department of Agriculture, which researches, tests and certifies the quality of production inputs such as chemical, organic and bio-fertilisers and agricultural hazardous substances
it: The Department of Agriculture's work on production inputs

te: Approaches to promoting the use of good-quality rice seed
se: The meeting considered approaches to promoting variety development and the supply of good-quality rice seed. It felt that besides building farmers' knowledge and skills, good seed helps cut costs, responds well to fertiliser, adapts well to the environment and builds confidence in the quality of Thai rice
it: Approaches to promoting variety development and the supply of good-quality rice seed

te: Production inputs reviewed, and further study issues set
se: The meeting reviewed the information on production inputs studied so far and discussed further issues to study so that every dimension is covered. It felt that approaches to supporting farmers' rice production should be studied, such as variety development and the supply of good-quality seed suited to each area
it: Summary of information on production inputs and issues for further study

te: Briefing by the Department of Internal Trade on fertiliser and pesticide prices
se: The meeting considered production inputs that affect the rice system, in particular the oversight of fertiliser and pesticide prices. It heard a representative of the Department of Internal Trade on the situation and trends in prices and volumes for the 2025 rice planting season, price oversight measures, and the results of enforcing the Prices of Goods and Services Act B.E. 2542 (1999)
it: Oversight of fertiliser and pesticide prices

te: Briefing by the Department of Internal Trade on scales and paddy buying at rice mills
se: The meeting considered checks on quality and standards in buying paddy at rice mills, and the oversight of weighing, measuring and moisture-measuring instruments so that they are certified under the law and farmers get a fair price. It invited a representative of the Department of Internal Trade, Ministry of Commerce, to give information
it: Oversight of weighing, measuring and moisture-measuring instruments in paddy buying

te: Measures to keep rice field rents fair
se: Agenda: measures to control rice field rents under the Agricultural Land Lease Act B.E. 2524 (1981) and its amendment of B.E. 2559 (2016), with the Permanent Secretary for Interior invited (the Senate has not yet published the summary of this meeting, so this text is the agenda in the meeting notice, not a resolution of the meeting)
it: Measures to control rice field rents under the Agricultural Land Lease Act B.E. 2524 (1981) and its amendment of B.E. 2559 (2016)

te: Key factors in the rice system considered, starting with seed development
se: The meeting considered the key factors in developing an integrated rice system, starting with rice seed development, where the Department of Agricultural Extension, the Department of Agriculture and the Rice Department aim to improve varieties that resist disease, tolerate weather and give high yields. It also considered limits such as the long time needed for breeding
it: Key factors in developing an integrated rice system: seed development

te: Work begins: order appointing the integrated rice system subcommittee noted
se: The meeting noted Order No. 9/2568 of the Committee on Agriculture and Cooperatives appointing the 12-member subcommittee to study and develop an integrated rice system, and began setting out how it will work
